en: Oi! Another challenger? Team Yell's backing Marnie, and Marnie only. You'd best go home!
We're not moving from this counter till every room's ours. Yell, yell, yell!
Now then! The gym challenge is a celebration. I won't have challengers kept from their rest by shouting.
The chairman? Right, we're off. This isn't over!
My apologies for that. Rose, chairman of the Pokémon League. And you must be one of Leon's endorsed challengers.
Rest well. Tomorrow the whole of Galar will be watching you. I look forward to the show!
{player} checked in and slept soundly. The morning of the opening ceremony came bright and loud.
Good luck in the challenge! We keep a room for every challenger, the night before the ceremony.
Welcome to the hotel. Challengers for the gym challenge have a room waiting.
